name: Itsuka no Sora
source:
Our hero is a sophomore college student living by himself. He has a childhood friend that is a girl, but he doesn't have a real girlfriend. His hope of finding someone special is fading away when his part time job eats up his time. Then he meets Eri, who happens to have lost her memory. The encounter with Eri leads our hero towards his destiny and forces him to search for his true identity...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030214173438/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/a/itsukanosora/]gamelexgs[/url]]
translation:
我们的英雄是一名独自生活的大二学生。他有一个儿时的朋友，是个女孩，但他没有真正的女朋友。当他的兼职工作耗尽了他的时间时，他找到一个特别的人的希望正在逐渐消失。然后他遇到了埃里，她碰巧失去了记忆。与埃里的相遇引导我们的英雄走向他的命运，并迫使他寻找他的真实身份……

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030214173438/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/a/itsukanosora/]gamelexgs[/url]]
